provenance.coupling: Block Gauss–Seidel co-simulation: switching timeline → bus energisation (NetworkX) → pump availability (energised and V ≥ 0.90 pu, latching undervoltage trip) → EPANET 2.2 extended-period hydraulics (60 s step, pressure-driven demand) → pump electrical demand P = ρgQH/η (pf 0.85) → pandapower AC Newton–Raphson power flow every frame → pump-bus voltage re-check; repeated until the pump schedule is a fixed point (≤ 4 iterations). Final run: 1 iteration(s), converged.

events.title: Normal operation
events.detail: Demand 3417 kW (incl. 43 kW pumping), Vmin 0.919 pu at B18; 2/2 pumps running, tanks T1 50%, T2 50%; minimum service pressure 36.9 m.

events.title: Fault on Feeder F3 · line B32–B33
SW-06-26 tripped
events.detail: Protection opened SW-06-26: 8 buses (B26, B27, B28, B29, B30, B31, B32, B33) de-energised, 869 kW interrupted; facilities affected: City Hospital, Pumping Station PS-2, District Cooling Plant DC-1.

events.title: City Hospital on backup generation
events.detail: Genset 150 kW carries the essential electrical load; it does not supply water.

events.title: PU-2 stopped (PS-2 duty pump)
events.detail: Supply bus B33 de-energised; zone now depends on tank storage.

events.title: Faulted section isolated
events.detail: Opened SW-32-33; reclosed SW-06-26 — B26, B27, B28, B29, B30, B31, B32 re-energised. Isolated section: —; still de-energised: B33.

events.title: Cascading impact evaluated
events.detail: Without further switching: 1 healthy bus (B33, 56 kW) remains de-energised; PU-2 offline; projected: Tank T2 below 25% at 17:40; projected: City Hospital pressure below 20 m at 18:12 (coupled power flow + extended-period hydraulic projection).

events.title: 5 recovery candidates evaluated
events.detail: Each candidate solved with AC power flow and the extended-period hydraulic model; 4 feasible, 1 rejected (1 undervoltage).

events.title: Plan C04 Simulation Verified
events.detail: Close SW-18-33 · shed B18. Independent re-solve: 8 hard checks passed; advisories: Voltage advisory (soft).

events.title: B18 shed
events.detail: Supplied non-critical load (84 kW, 36 connections) interrupted to create voltage headroom for the restoration path.

events.title: PU-2 restarted
events.detail: Supply restored at B33; pumping 43.3 L/s at 33.9 m (19.5 kW).

events.title: 76 kW restored
events.detail: Re-energised B33 via the verified plan; 84 kW shed (B18), net -8 kW.

events.title: End of simulation horizon
events.detail: Served 3830 of 3924 kW (94 kW shed by the plan: B18); 2/2 pumps running; critical-facility pressure 38.2 m; tanks T1 53%, T2 55%.

timeline.label: Service restored
timeline.detail: 91% net restoration at end of horizon (restored ÷ restored + unserved); B18 shed by the plan

Switching is executed remotely at the switching time; the faulted section stays isolated for the horizon.

Encirra objective: weighted served energy, critical energy, water delivered, critical water-service hours and storage, minus switching cost (weights in the run).
